legal_ref: Codul fiscal nr. 1163/1997, Titlul III, art. 96 lit. a)
quote: art. 96 lit. a) cota-standard – în mărime de 20% din valoarea impozabilă a mărfurilor şi serviciilor importate şi a livrărilor efectuate pe teritoriul Republicii Moldova — standard rate of 20% of the taxable value of imported goods and services and of supplies made in Moldova.
source_title: Monitorul Fiscal FISC.MD — Q&A 28.17.1 'Ce cote sînt stabilite pentru livrările de mărfuri...' (quotes art. 96 Codul fiscal; version after Law 229/2018). Official portals legis.md and sfs.md returned HTTP 403 / JS-only content.

reduced_rates.scope: bread and bakery products, milk and dairy, medicines (3001-3004), medical supplies, natural and liquefied gas, agricultural/horticultural production, beet sugar, solid biofuel (art. 96 lit. b)); HoReCa supplies incl. accommodation and food/drink services (CAEM section I) — history 15% (2020) → 6% (2021 emergency) → 12% → 8% under Law 212/2023; SFS confirmed 8% unchanged on 26.03.2026

notes: Government draft law (MF no. 284/2025) amends art. 96 lit. b) fourth indent only (not the standard rate). Emergency declared 24.03.2026 did not change HoReCa rate (SFS statement via logos-pres.md). Transnistria region outside effective administration.
unverified: valid_from: start date of the 20% standard rate not found in an accessible official text (VAT under Title III Codul fiscal since 1998)
standard rate and reduced-rate list taken from Monitorul Fiscal FISC.MD Q&A 28.17.1 (secondary); legis.md and sfs.md blocked (HTTP 403 / JS-only)
